title: GP-ANN OGP Partition Parameters
description: Parameters exposed by the selected official Partition CLI subprocess. Epsilon is intentionally absent because the CLI fixes it to 0.05.

requested_num_clusters.description: Semantic preflight additionally requires this value not to exceed the admitted Dataset global node count.

requested_overlap.description: Must be finite under the repository JSON-compatible input rules. The official source declares no general upper bound; semantic preflight performs overflow-safe overlap*N arithmetic.
